title: #066. Cross-Docking Door & Flow Synchronization
subtitle: Assign inbound and outbound trucks to cross-dock doors while matching commodity flows and arrival-departure time synchronization.
caseNames: 4 inbound x 3 outbound with door congestion
5 inbound x 4 outbound with tight due windows

judge.m0: Output must be an object { inDoor, outDoor, flows, departures, totalCost }.
judge.m4: {p0}[{p1}] must be an integer door index in 0..{p3} (received {p2}).
judge.m5: Inbound door {p0} handles {p1} trucks exceeding door capacity {p2}.
judge.m7: Outbound door {p0} handles {p1} trucks exceeding door capacity {p2}.
judge.m8: Inbound truck {p0} shipped {p2} of commodity {p1} exceeding supply {p3}.
judge.m9: Outbound truck {p0} received {p2} of commodity {p1}, below demand {p3}.
judge.m10: Outbound truck {p0} departs at {p1} before freight from inbound truck {p2} finishes transfer at {p3}.
judge.m11: Reported totalCost ({p0}) does not match recomputed handling + delay cost ({p1}).
judge.m12: Valid cross-docking schedule, but totalCost ({p0}) exceeds minimum ({p1}).
